title: Cole
description: You hear how Coal and Cole sound similar? How about turning it into something you can see?
body:
### What does this do?
You hear how Coal and Cole sound similar? How about turning it into something you can see? This is exactly what I did here.

### WHY?
Simple answer: Because.

### Will there be more SkyBlock Mayor - Ore connections?
Yes of course, who wouldn't want to constantly be stared at while mining?
